title: A 1400°C laboratory furnace: continuous operating temperature and measurement range
summary: A Suneng discussion draft for a high-temperature laboratory chamber furnace proposes a maximum working temperature of 1400°C and a continuous working temperature of 1300°C, but lists thermocouples with a range of 0–1300°C. These figures do not automatically establish a verified high-temperature capability. Procurement should confirm that the complete measurement configuration matches the intended operating range, then assess the loading platform and actual specimens.
